newsitem.title: USA: UPS may face pilots strike if pact not reached-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: UPS may face pilots strike if pact not reached-WSJ.

text.p: United Parcel Service may face a strike from its pilots union if a new contract is not reached in negotiations set to resume in a few weeks, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
The newspaper said in its electronic edition that the pilots voted this spring to authorise a strike if a new contract is not reached.
Industry analysts said that if a pilots strike occurs, the impact on UPS' consumer confidence would be profound.
Closely held UPS has already lost some $300 million as a result of the ongoing Teamsters strike, analysts told the paper.
UPS declined to comment on the possibility of labour problems with its pilots, the paper said.
